info.name: Returns a yearly timetable for the supplied modules.

params.name: modules
params.description: A comma-separated list of the module codes you want the timetable of. You can supply either standard module codes (e.g. COMP0133), or full codes including the instance of the module (COMP0133-A7U-T1). Note that if you do not supply an instance, every single timetable entry will be returned including duplicates for the same module taught as multiple instances. It is recommended that a full module code including instance be supplied.

params.name: date
params.description: A date to filter entries by

items.docs: Returns a yearly timetable for the supplied modules.

info.name: Returns a list of every module taught on a given course at UCL.

params.name: course
params.description: The course ID available from /data/courses.

params.name: term_1
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances that are taught in term 1.

params.name: term_2
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances that are taught in term 2.

params.name: term_3
params.description: Boolean designating whether or not you want module instances that are taught in term 3.

params.name: term_1_next_year
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances that are taught in term 1 of the next academic year. This is used by admissions to calculate the end dates for non-standard programmes, and therefore is rare

params.name: summer
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances that are timetabled in the summer. This can happen in some Postgraduate and Medicine teaching arrangements, but is rare. Note that this is NOT the same as the UCL Summer School.

params.name: year_long
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances where the course is timetabled to last for an entire academic year.

params.name: lsr
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances where the module is timetabled during the Late Summer Resit period. This is used internally by Examinations to timetable Late Summer Assessments (LSAs).

params.name: is_summer_school
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances where the course is taught as part of the UCL Summer School (true) or standard academic teaching (false).

params.name: session_1
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances where the module is taught in the first summer school session of this academic year's summer.

params.name: session_2
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like module instances where the module is taught in the second summer school session of this academic year's summer.

params.name: is_undergraduate
params.description: Boolean designating if you would like undergraduate module instances.

params.name: only_available
params.description: Boolean designating if you would only like available module instances (i.e. ones that are not compulsory for the course).

params.name: only_compulsory
params.description: Boolean designating if you would only like compulsory module instances.

items.docs: Returns a list of every module taught on a given course at UCL.
